title: api.heywobo.com in Railway
detail: Service wobo → Settings → Networking → Custom Domain → api.heywobo.com. Paste the CNAME target it shows.

title: Wordmark and icon: your go
detail: Solid wordmark as primary, sticker as secondary; the eyes icon with ultramarine pupils. Say go and I generate the whole icon set.

title: Company legal name and postal address
detail: The legal set and the email footer carry placeholders.

title: Rotate the Railway project token
detail: It passed through the terminal and this chat. Project settings → Tokens.

title: Railway: two hourly crons and four variables
detail: POST /v1/internal/mail/sunday and /v1/internal/mail/wishes with header X-Wobo-Internal; set EMAIL_MODE=live, EMAIL_REPLY_TO=help@heywobo.com, EMAIL_POSTAL_ADDRESS (your legal address), MAIL_LOG_PATH on a volume.

title: Plans page extras: approve or strike
detail: Pro adds voice replies and longer full-board lessons; Max adds two learners and past-paper sets. Your multipliers (5×, 20×) and prices are as set.

title: 22 festival wishes need your line
detail: Durga Puja/Navratri, Ganesh Chaturthi, Eid al-Adha, Good Friday, Nowruz, Passover, Dashain and others send nothing until a one-line English wish passes the neutral gate.

title: Help article 07 names two account brands
detail: The public Ask Wobo replaces any reply naming them with the honest line. Your ruling on §17 vs a faithful 'Can I sign in with Google?' answer decides the article's wording.

title: Railway: a third hourly cron is not needed, but the gateway must redeploy
detail: The image now ships the help copy for the public Ask Wobo; redeploy after the next push so /v1/ask answers in production.

title: Model credit is empty — Ask Wobo cannot answer
detail: The Anthropic account says the credit balance is too low, so covered questions get a 503 and only the honest line works. Add credit or billing.

title: Anonymous sign-ins are disabled in Supabase
detail: The live site tries to mint an anonymous session on load and gets a 422 on every page. Either turn anonymous sign-ins on, or I stop the app asking on public routes.

title: Supabase service role key for the gateway
detail: Needed before the Sunday note and the parent link can read and write their tables in production.
